as_of: Curated Aug 2026 from 2025-season offensive line play. Hand-edited — adjust tiers as camp news lands. 1 = elite, 2 = good, 3 = average, 4 = below average, 5 = bad.

PHI.note: Best line in football for years; elite run blocking

DEN.note: Elite pass pro, top-tier unit across the board

DET.note: Elite when healthy; mauling run game

BAL.note: Top run-blocking unit, scheme multiplies it

TB.note: Quietly excellent interior, strong in both phases

ARI.note: Improved into a good run-blocking line

SF.note: Scheme + Williams keep it above average

IND.note: Nelson anchors a good run-blocking group

CHI.note: Bought the interior in 2025; much improved

NYJ.note: Decent when the tackles are healthy

WAS.note: Middle of the pack, better in pass pro

JAX.note: Middling; better in pass pro than run

CIN.note: Perennial weak spot, run blocking especially

NYG.note: Still one of the shakier units
